CHHapticDynamicParameter.doc: A value that you send to a haptic pattern player to alter a property value during playback.

CHHapticEngine.doc: An object that represents the connection to the haptic server.

CHHapticEvent.doc: An object that describes a single haptic or audio event.

CHHapticEventParameter.doc: A static parameter value that represents a single property of the haptic pattern.

CHHapticParameterCurve.doc: A curve that you send to a haptic pattern player to alter a property value gradually during playback.

CHHapticParameterCurveControlPoint.doc: A single control point in a parameter curve.

CHHapticPattern.doc: An object representing a haptic waveform.

CHHapticAdvancedPatternPlayer.doc: A protocol that defines an advanced pattern player capable of looping, seeking, pausing, and resuming haptic playback.

CHHapticDeviceCapability.doc: A protocol that defines haptics and audio capabilities of a device.

CHHapticParameterAttributes.doc: A protocol for providing default, mininum, and maximum values of a parameter.

CHHapticPatternPlayer.doc: A protocol that defines a standard pattern player capable of playing haptic patterns with fixed parameters.

CHHapticEngineFinishedAction.doc: Possible actions to take after the haptic engine finishes execution.

CHHapticEngineStoppedReason.doc: The enumeration of reasons the haptic engine stopped running.

-initWithParameterID:value:relativeTime:.doc: Creates a dynamic parameter from its ID, value, and start time.

+capabilitiesForHardware.doc: Returns a device capability object that describes the device’s haptic support and limitations.

-createAdvancedPlayerWithPattern:error:.doc: Creates an advanced haptic pattern player from a haptic pattern.

-createPlayerWithPattern:error:.doc: Creates a standard haptic pattern player from a haptic pattern.

-initAndReturnError:.doc: Creates an instance of the haptic engine.

-initWithAudioSession:error:.doc: Creates a haptic engine from an audio session.

-notifyWhenPlayersFinished:.doc: Notifies you when all haptic pattern players have finished playing their haptic patterns.

-playPatternFromData:error:.doc: Plays a pattern from the specified data.

-playPatternFromURL:error:.doc: Plays a pattern that’s defined in a file at the specified URL.

-registerAudioResource:options:error:.doc: Registers an external audio to use as a custom waveform.

-stopWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Asynchronously stops the haptic engine and executes the completion handler once the engine has stopped.

-unregisterAudioResource:error:.doc: Unregisters an external audio file that you previously registered with the engine.

-initWithAudioResourceID:parameters:rela.doc: Initializes a haptic event from a previously loaded audio resource, specifying event parameters and start time.
Initializes a haptic event from a previously loaded audio resource, specifying event parameters, start time, and duration.

-initWithEventType:parameters:relativeTi.doc: Initializes a haptic event of the specified type, parameters, and start time.
Initializes a haptic event of the specified type, parameters, start time, and duration.

-initWithParameterID:value:.doc: Creates a haptic event parameter from its ID and value.

-initWithParameterID:controlPoints:relat.doc: Creates a parameter curve from its parameter ID, control points, and start time.

-exportDictionaryAndReturnError:.doc: Returns the dictionary representation of the haptic pattern.

-initWithContentsOfURL:error:.doc: Creates a haptic pattern with the contents of an AHAP file.

-initWithDictionary:error:.doc: Creates a haptic pattern from a property list dictionary.

-initWithEvents:parameterCurves:error:.doc: Constructs a haptic pattern from a series of events and parameter curves.

-initWithEvents:parameters:error:.doc: Constructs a haptic pattern from a series of events and parameters.

CHHapticDynamicParameterID.doc: The identifier that reveals the type of property associated with a dynamic parameter.

parameterID.doc: The dynamic parameter ID defining the type of parameter being modified.

relativeTime.doc: The time at which this dynamic parameter is applied, relative to the start time of the pattern.

value.doc: The value of the dynamic parameter.

CHHapticCompletionHandler.doc: A typealias for a completion handler that the engine calls after starting or stopping.

CHHapticEngineFinishedAction.doc: Possible actions to take after the haptic engine finishes execution.

CHHapticEngineFinishedHandler.doc: A type alias for a completion handler to execute after finishing haptic playback.

CHHapticEngineResetHandler.doc: A typealias for the block that the haptic engine calls after being reset.

CHHapticEngineStoppedHandler.doc: A typealias for the block that the haptic engine calls after it stops due to an external cause.

CHHapticEngineStoppedReason.doc: The enumeration of reasons the haptic engine stopped running.

autoShutdownEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the haptic engine starts and stops automatically on request from one of its pattern players, or when idle.

currentTime.doc: The absolute time, in seconds, to use for scheduling haptic and audio events.

isMutedForAudio.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the engine mutes audio.

isMutedForHaptics.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the engine mutes haptics.

playsAudioOnly.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the engine ignores haptic events and plays audio events only.

playsHapticsOnly.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the engine ignores audio events.

resetHandler.doc: A block that the haptic engine calls after recovering from a haptic server error.

stoppedHandler.doc: A closure the haptic engine calls when it stops due to external causes.

CHHapticEventParameterID.doc: An identifier for an event parameter.

CHHapticEventType.doc: The types of audio and haptic event waveforms.

duration.doc: The duration of the haptic event.

eventParameters.doc: An array of event parameters, possibly empty.

relativeTime.doc: The start time of the event, relative to other events in the same pattern.

type.doc: The type of the haptic event.

parameterID.doc: The haptic parameter ID indicating what type of parameter the current event represents.

CHHapticParameterCurveControlPoint.doc: A single control point in a parameter curve.

controlPoints.doc: An array containing the curve’s control points.

parameterID.doc: The parameter ID defining the type of parameter that the curve represents.

relativeTime.doc: The time at which this parameter curve is applied, relative to the start time of the pattern.

CHHapticPatternKey.doc: Constants that define the keys you use to create a haptic pattern dictionary.

duration.doc: The duration of the haptic pattern, in seconds.
